images.body:
Signature feature
A computer that knows when a card matters
— Easy: weighs a card on a copy of the table — targets, the board it leaves, turns won or lost
— Medium / Hard: plays the match to the end 40 / 100 times, with and without the card, same dice in both branches
— Won 64% of 160 matches against the old always-reveal computer; ~0.5 s per decision in the browser
— The card it plays stays on screen with a spotlight, long enough to read
Real capture: the computer reveals “Grip of Apophis” mid-match

The physical product behind the site
Box, two boards, cones & spools, throw sticks, 8 Heka cards, bilingual rule sheets — 3D renders from the print and factory files

Architecture — one rules engine, two places it runs
Landing & ordersStory, box, games, cards, FAQ · cash-on-delivery form · cities per governorate · invoice e-mail
Playable demovs computer (3 levels) · two on one device · online · Heka cards on/off · WebAudio sounds
Owner dashboardPrices, trials, shipping table, tracker ids, content · orders · funnel analytics
▼
apps/web — Next.js 15 · next-intl · Tailwind 4 · zod at every boundaryfeatures/: landing · demo · online · orders · players · settings · analytics · admin
Online: the server throws the sticks and keeps face-down cards; browsers poll ~1 s
Players & trialsSigned device cookie · 6-digit e-mail code (hashed, 15 min, 5 tries, rate-limited) · trials counted on the server
